title: Chapter 236: Expanding The City Wall
content:
Chapter 236: Expanding The City Wall

"Lord, there are still more than 20 days before the undead army attacks. It is enough for us to build the new city wall. In addition, in the past month, the population of the territory will definitely increase tremendously."

Suo Yong said seriously.

Wang Shuo then thought about it. He had planned to attack Nanshanji in half a month. Will the population still be a problem by then?

"Lord, I think our city wall should be built stronger. This will enhance the defensive strength. Simply reducing the defensive area is not the best option."

After weighing the pros and cons, Wang Shuo finally decided to build the city wall again on a large scale.

"Okay, then we will build Wana Village to the size of a small town. Once we have the heart of the town, we will upgrade the town in one step."

"Yes, Lord Lord (boss)."

After having the preliminary plan, Wang Shuo called Yan Fujie over and left him in charge of the construction of the city wall.

Yan Fujie was even more talented than Wang Shuo in making bronze city wall bricks.

During this period, he has been in charge of the brick kiln, and the firing of bronze city bricks has never stopped.

"How many bronze city bricks are there now?" Wang Shuo looked at Yan Fujie with a smile.

"Back to the lord, there are more than 1 million yuan now." Yan Fujie said with his hands in hand.

Is that too much?

Wang Shuo had a look of surprise on his face.

After thinking about it, it was almost done. It has been more than 10 days since the current city wall was built.

As the population of the territory increased, the number of masons also increased. The production of 100,000 bricks per day was not a lot.

Wang Shuo immediately went to inspect the brick kiln.

At this time, the soil on the surface has basically been exposed.

underground.

They are collecting soil and building underground shelters at the same time.

Wang Shuo nodded with satisfaction.

"Whose idea was this?"

The three of them were a little unsure about Wang Shuo's attitude!

Duan Wenxi said anxiously: "Boss, Lao Yan discussed this matter with us. At that time, you were busy leading the troops to fight, so we made the decision on our own!"

"Well, you did a great job!"

Wang Shuo said with a smile.

The creativity of players is much better than that of tool people!

If a brainless tool man was found to take charge of this matter, a huge hole would have appeared in Wang Shuo's territory.

After all, one million bricks would require as much soil as a hill.

500,000 bricks were used to build the previous city wall.

If you want to build a city wall on the scale of a small town, the city wall bricks used will probably cost about 3 million.

It is indeed a difficult project.

Wang Shuo handed over the construction of the city wall to Yan Fujie.

"The production of city wall bricks cannot stop, the more the better!" Wang Shuo patted Yan Fujie on the shoulder and said.

He also hopes that this city wall brick can bring a lot of revenue to the territory!

Now Wang Shuo also has a trump card product that can sell well, and that is the Necromancer Pearl.

After continuous research, Wang Shuo has now been able to completely produce it, but it is a bit time-consuming and laborious.

Wang Shuo planned to leave the unimportant processes to others.

In this way, the production efficiency will inevitably be greatly improved.

Just as he was told, he directly asked Duan Wenxi to select dozens of citizens and process the gloomy wood into the prototype of the Necromantic Pearl according to the requirements.

Several more citizens were selected to learn how to draw the basic Death Soul Gathering Formation.

Of course, Wang Shuo did not let them understand the most important core technology.

In this way, you only need to perform the finishing touches and that's it.

After everything in the territory has been arranged in an orderly manner.

Wang Shuo planned to go to Nanshanji in person to explore the truth.
